from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single 所有者权益合计 value from one company's financial report."""
    report_period: str = Field(description="Which quarterly report this is from (e.g., '2020年第一季度')")
    snapshot_date: str = Field(description="The specific balance sheet date for this value")
    equity_value_yuan: float = Field(description="所有者权益合计 amount in yuan")
    value_type: str = Field(description="Whether this is beginning_balance or ending_balance for the period")
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="Reference to where this was found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_data_points: list[EquityDataPoint]
